sources-consulted.formula: Distinct primary sources a search task recorded, read beside uncited-claims and claims-unverified.

uncited-claims.formula: Claims in the note without a source that has both a URL and an access date.

claims-unverified.formula: Claims whose verdict is hearsay or refuted, divided by all claims in the note.

claim-review-rounds.formula: Rounds of the review loop until the citation check and the claim review both passed.

question-turnaround.formula: Time from the org.research-question event to the published note.
